interpretation: Lower levels are continuation-risk checkpoints while bullish drive conditions remain active.
The transition level marks the shift from early continuation risk toward the main reaction-watch area.
The primary bullish reaction zone is the highest-priority upside reaction-watch area from the mirror cascade layer.
Deep extension levels can be reactive, but are extended and context-dependent rather than automatic reversal calls.
